verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a real Namecheap API (api.namecheap.com/xml.response) with a sandbox environment (api.sandbox.namecheap.com), indicating a documented public API exists for programmatic domain/DNS management, and a separate RDAP API for domain lookups. However, the evidence only shows raw endpoint URLs and error responses (missing APIUser parameter) rather than actual API documentation content, authentication flow, or SDK/agent-friendly design. Missing for 10: authentication/API-key documentation, rate limits, request/response schema examples, and any AI-agent or automation-specific tooling around the API.
